newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOXING-ARBACHAKOV RETAINS WBC FLYWEIGHT TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-ARBACHAKOV RETAINS WBC FLYWEIGHT TITLE.

text.p: Yuri Arbachakov of Russia retained his World Boxing Council (WBC) flyweight title on Monday by stopping Japan's Takato Toguchi in the ninth round.

In his ninth successful title defence, 29-year-old Arbachakov knocked Toguchi to the canvas twice in the seventh round before referee Nobuaki Uratani ended the scheduled 12-round fight a minute and 29 seconds into the ninth.
Japan-based Arbachakov extended his unbeaten professional record to 23 victories with 16 knockouts, while 26-year-old Taguchi, the WBC's eighth-ranked challenger, stands on 18 wins and three losses.
